summary: Frontend-only UI test of premium credit-card-style PolicyCard on /dashboard and /policies for demo user. Logged in as demo@insurtech.io. Component renders correctly with all required elements: Afinity.ai brand, shield logo, formatted 4-4-4-4 policy number, holder name, Valid From/Thru in MM/YY, chip, contactless icon, gold variant. Aspect ratio is exactly 1.586 on dashboard. Side-sheet detail shows PolicyCard at top followed by all policy details (Policy #, Status, Start/End dates, Coverage, Premium, Tier, Destination). View all link present. Lint passes for all 3 files.

issues: Both the outer wrapping <button> in MyPolicies and the inner PolicyCard component use the data-testid prefix 'policy-card-'. The button uses 'policy-card-{policy_number}' and the inner div uses 'policy-card-{id}'. While the exact ids are different, the shared prefix produces 2 hits per policy when querying with [data-testid^='policy-card-']. Consider renaming outer wrapper to something like 'policy-card-trigger-{policy_number}' for cleaner test selectors. Non-blocking.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add a SheetDescription or aria-describedby to SheetContent for accessibility. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: rename outer button data-testid in MyPolicies.jsx (line 67) to 'policy-card-trigger-{policy_number}' to avoid prefix collision with the inner PolicyCard's 'policy-card-{id}'.
Optional: add SheetDescription / aria-describedby to SheetContent in MyPolicies.jsx to silence Radix Dialog accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PolicyCard.jsx is a clean, self-contained component with three palettes; aspect ratio uses native CSS aspectRatio (1.586/1) as required by ISO ID-1. Empty/undefined fields are handled with sensible defaults (POLICY HOLDER, padded zeros).
Dashboard slices to top 4 active policies in a 2-col grid — good UX. Variant cycling via idx % 3 alternates gold / obsidian / platinum.
MyPolicies side-sheet always uses 'gold' variant for the detail card — this is intentional and reads well.
Minor: shared data-testid prefix between wrapper button and inner PolicyCard could confuse Playwright queries (see frontend_issues).
test_credentials: demo@insurtech.io / Demo@123 (used). Existing Travel Shield Global active policy was already seeded; no new seed needed.
seed_data_creation: None — demo user already has 1 active policy (TR-260427-98635, Travel Shield Global).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium credit-card PolicyCard is working end-to-end on /dashboard (1 card, gold variant, 1.586 ratio confirmed) and /policies (cards + click-to-open Sheet with PolicyCard at top + details). Demo customer 'Demo Customer' has policy_number TR-260427-98635 padded to TR26 0427 9863 5000 with 04/26 - 05/26 validity. Empty-state code paths exist (active.length === 0 on Dashboard; policies.length === 0 on MyPolicies) but were not exercisable with demo since they have a policy — code review of both branches looked correct (Shield icon + 'Explore plans' CTA).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All acceptance criteria for the PolicyCard iteration are met visually and structurally.
